title: IsoDDE: Unified AI Drug Design Engine Surpassing AlphaFold 3 on Novel Pockets & Affinity
whyItMatters: More than doubled AlphaFold 3’s accuracy on hard out-of-distribution protein–ligand generalization, beat AF3 by 2.3× on antibody–antigen interfaces, predicted binding affinities, and uncovered a cryptic pocket in cereblon.
summary: In February 2026, Isomorphic Labs (the Alphabet/DeepMind drug-discovery spinout) published its technical report on the Isomorphic Labs Drug Design Engine (IsoDDE), moving beyond AlphaFold 3’s biomolecular structure prediction into unified small-molecule and biologic drug design. On the hardest out-of-distribution protein–ligand benchmarks—testing pockets and chemical scaffolds furthest from training data—IsoDDE more than doubled AlphaFold 3’s success rate, beat AlphaFold 3 by 2.3× on high-accuracy antibody–antigen interface predictions, delivered physics-grade binding-affinity predictions without experimental co-crystal structures, and predicted a novel experimentally confirmed allosteric cryptic binding site on cereblon.
technicalHighlights: More than doubled AlphaFold 3’s accuracy on the hardest out-of-distribution protein–ligand generalization benchmarks (~50% vs ~25%).
Achieved 2.3× higher success rate than AlphaFold 3 on high-accuracy antibody–antigen interface prediction.
Unified structure prediction with binding-affinity estimation and de novo cryptic-pocket identification, identifying a novel allosteric binding site in cereblon.
caveats: IsoDDE is proprietary and closed-weights; benchmark claims come from Isomorphic Labs’ technical report prior to independent academic peer review, and IsoDDE-designed therapeutics have not yet completed human clinical efficacy trials.

scoreRationale.foundational: Bridged the long-standing gap between out-of-distribution biomolecular folding, cryptic-pocket discovery, and quantitative binding affinity.
scoreRationale.ripple: Signals the transition of AlphaFold-lineage AI from structural biology benchmarks to industrial small-molecule and antibody pipelines.
scoreRationale.verification: Backed by a detailed technical report and internal experimental case studies (e.g., cereblon), but proprietary and not yet independently peer-reviewed.
scoreRationale.velocity: Compresses months of physics-based FEP simulations and structural pocket hunting into unified neural inference.
